title: Email: Fw: Anthony, you were quoted in Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day!

content.subject: Fw: Anthony, you were quoted in Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day!

content.text:
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Tuesday, October 29, 2019 3:24 PM
To: Brown, Laura <lbrown@m-w.com>
Subject: Re: Anthony, you were quoted in Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day! 
 
Don't sweat it. I should've let you know but It's kind of a running gag with my followers, since everybody spells my name wrong. I think the word of the day is a great idea.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Brown, Laura <lbrown@m-w.com>
Sent: Tuesday, October 29, 2019 2:28 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Anthony, you were quoted in Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day! 
 
Hi Anthony,
Thanks for the tweet and apologies for the initial misspelling of your last name. We corrected it as soon as we caught it.
It’s especially embarrassing when we write the dictionary and we have a misspelling in something we post. We appreciate your understanding.

From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> 
Sent: Tuesday, October 29, 2019 1:52 PM
To: Brown, Laura <lbrown@m-w.com>
Subject: Re: Anthony, you were quoted in Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day!
Thank you! I'll tweet it again with my name spelled right. It happens all the time. That's funny, though.

From: Brown, Laura <lbrown@m-w.com>
Sent: Tuesday, October 29, 2019 12:30 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Anthony, you were quoted in Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day!

We wanted to let you know that you were quoted in today’s Merriam-Webster Word of the Day. You can view today’s Word of the Day on our website here:  https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/lackadaisical-2019-10-29
Here is today’s Word of the Day tweet, if you’d like to share that on your Twitter feed: https://twitter.com/MerriamWebster/status/1189149884797968390
